slides.headline: 30 HOMES MARKED FOR DEMOLITION
slides.body: Georgia Power, a for-profit utility, plans to tear down roughly 30 homes and seize 330 parcels of land across the state. All to build a 1,000-mile transmission line feeding a new power plant producing nearly 10,000 megawatts

slides.headline: 80% GOES STRAIGHT TO DATA CENTERS
slides.body: The Georgia Public Service Commission confirmed that nearly 80% of the new plant's output is earmarked for data centers. Regular families and businesses split whatever's left. The homes are being torn down to power servers, not neighborhoods

slides.headline: THE HOMEOWNERS CAN'T SAY NO
slides.body: If a homeowner refuses to sell, Georgia Power can legally force them out using eminent domain, the government's power to take your property whether you agree or not. One resident told Fortune: "We don't have a choice in this"

slides.headline: BUSINESSES HANDED AI THEIR WORST TASKS
slides.body: They're building a 10,000 megawatt power plant just to run AI. Businesses that already use AI save hours every day on work that used to need a full team. No power plant required

slides.headline: GEORGIA WON'T BE THE LAST
slides.body: Follow: the next one could be closer to home. Send this to someone who has no idea AI needs this much power
